anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles or opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Evaluate and enhance AI model training and opportunity generation to ensure the AI system is contributing effectively.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are active and generating trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's reliability.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and capable of generating learning cycles and opportunities.
